dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Hey, kiddo. You've been staring at us for quite some time now. Do you have something to say to us or what?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Wow! Are you looking for me, furry one?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Did you actually hear what I was thinking??? Are the two of you Adepti or something...?

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Huh? "Furry one"? "Adepti"...? What? We're the best pro detectives here in Snezhnograd, kiddo! Ever heard of the Mystery-Hunters?

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: We chase and uncover the hidden truth! And we complete the most impossible commissions!

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: Well said! But Boss... why did you let on our identities just like that...?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Mmm, I don't quite understand. What's a "pro detective"? Are you even better than the Adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Of course! Once, I picked out a really nasty criminal from a crowd of people. And I was the one who closed many of Snezhnograd's unsolved cases. Also——

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: And, and, we're also really good at finding all kinds of things! It can be a cat hiding in a tavern, a jacket with a hole in it, or a bunch of keys...

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: These are the kinds of jobs we usually get these days, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Oh, okay. So you're good at finding things... In that case, I have a commission for you, misters! Would the two of you help find me a new friend? I can give you all my pocket money!

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: I just moved here, and all my friends are so far away... My dad and mom are so busy too...

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: Aw, you poor kid. You were just like m—— Boss, why not let the kid join us? At the very least, being a detective will keep him from sitting around and twiddling his thumbs.

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Join us? AHEM, AHEM!!! Alright, I suppose we can start cultivating them from when they're young... That's another way to get a pro detective! But what do you think, kiddo?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: I'm, I'm okay I guess... But will I grow hair all over once I become a detective? I don't mind being a furry one, but I'm not sure if my dad and mum can recognize me if I turn into one...

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: What? Of course not! Becoming a detective doesn't turn you into some weird monster.

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Looks like you've lots to learn about life here. But that's alright, that can be remedied in time...

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Alright, the two of you. Get yourselves together. Our next target is about to show up!

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Let me guess, it'll be another client asking us to stand in a line somewhere for them. Hmm... maybe someone like that young lady over there, the really well-dressed one with a bouquet of flowers in her hand. Definitely not the kind of person who'd stand in a crazy line a second longer than they have to!

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: There are so many people here... How I wish I could get away from all this right now... I can't stand this anymore, I can't breathe... I don't want to stand in line for someone else ever again.

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Don't say that in front of the kid, Vadim! We must understand that the road to becoming a Legendary Detective is indeed a long and arduous one!

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Do you think you can do it, Qiaoqiao?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: From what you've been saying, mister Vadim, I'm only a Detective Apprentice, and a really long way off from making Legendary Detective...

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Ugh, the two of you, you'll be the... Never mind. I have a feeling our next client will be a big one...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: They look so soft and glossy... how I wish I could touch them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you wanna touch?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Huh? I'm looking at the two furry ones over there...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Are they the "Adepti" my parents have told me about? But I remember them telling me that an Adeptus is sometimes human, and sometimes an animal... but they seem to be both man and animal at the same time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoqiao
dialogues.text: Okay, goodbye...
